summary: Iteration 94 fork retest — P4 (/portal/prescription-analysis page vide) and P5 (superviseur doctor scoping). P4 CONFIRMED FIXED: page renders for super-admin AND for tracked Médecin (sidebar link 'Analyse prescription' works); all 11 required data-testids present and visible; add/remove prescription rows work; submit calls /api/vidal/prescription/analyze and renders rx-analyze-result (VIDAL sandbox unreachable -> documented error passthrough). P5 CONFIRMED FIXED end-to-end: seeded Superviseur (client A) sees only med-a (client A) in GET /api/me/planning/doctors, in the walk-in modal dropdown (walk-in-doctor-select) and in planning-doctor-filter; med-b (client B) never leaks. Backend: 30 passed / 1 skipped across the 6 fork test files (incl. new test_fork_p4_p5_extra.py).

minor.issue: Tracked Médecin (medecin-test@sawali-test.com, parent = super-admin) receives 403 'Module VIDAL non activé pour votre établissement' — the target role of the P4 sidebar link cannot actually run the analysis until features.vidal_enabled is set on his parent tenant. Frontend handles it gracefully (toast) but the feature is unusable for médecins by default.

VIDAL sandbox base URL is a placeholder (https://api-test.vidal.example) with app_id='fake' -> every analysis returns 'Erreur réseau VIDAL / Name or service not known' in the result block. Expected in preview, but the raw JSON dump (incl. request body/url) is shown to end users.
Repeated 404 in browser console on every portal page (placeholder file id referenced by branding/asset code). Pre-existing noise.

ui_bugs.issue: The centered circular loader (with %) re-appears repeatedly while idle on portal pages (background polling keeps re-triggering the axios interceptor), so a spinner flashes in the middle of the content area every few seconds. Cosmetic but distracting; consider ignoring polling/background calls.

Errors are only surfaced via a transient sonner toast; no persistent inline error state on the form (a médecin who misses the toast sees nothing happen after clicking 'Analyser la prescription'). Also the result block dumps raw JSON incl. the outgoing VIDAL request URL/body.
'Analyse prescription' link is shown to every tracked Médecin regardless of the tenant's features.vidal_enabled flag, leading to a dead-end 403.

issues: Date de naissance uses the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy, US format) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere — locale mismatch for a FR app
Large empty area below the form on 1920x1080 (form not vertically balanced)

action_items: Decide P4 follow-up: either enable features.vidal_enabled for tenants of tracked Médecins (or bypass the gate when parent is super-admin), or hide/disable the 'Analyse prescription' sidebar link when the module is off.
Add an inline (persistent) error/empty state to PrescriptionAnalysisForm instead of relying only on a toast; avoid dumping the raw VIDAL request (url/body/app_id) to end users.
Optional: use the shadcn date picker (FR locale) for rx-patient-birth instead of the native <input type=date>.
Optional: stop GlobalRouteLoader from re-triggering on background polling requests.
Optional: fix the recurring /api/files/abc-123-def 404 console noise.
